title: Time-windowed coalescing batcher with KV prefetching and memory compaction
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Implement and evaluate a time-windowed coalescing batcher that groups short, near-simultaneous requests while prefetching KV shards and triggering opportunistic GPU memory compaction to reduce fragmentation. Target workload: mixed prompt/response lengths (1-2048 tokens) with high tail variance from chatty clients. Rationale: continuous batching currently favors length-prioritized slotting that increases fragmentation and KV churn for mixed-length traffic. A short, configurable time window (2-12ms) for coalescing can increase aggregation for short requests without significantly harming p50 latency, and combined with KV prefetch heuristics we can reduce cache miss penalties and avoid long-term memory fragmentation by periodic compaction after eviction spikes.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end implementation behind feature flag with config controls: coalesce_window_ms (2-12), prefetch_enabled (bool), compaction_threshold (evictions/sec)
No more than 5% regression in p50 latency on benchmarks with synthetic mixed-length workload compared to baseline when feature flag enabled with conservative defaults
Reduction in tail (p99) KV miss penalty by at least 20% on at least two production-like traces when prefetch_enabled=true
Measured reduction in long-lived GPU allocator fragmentation (peak fragmentation metric) by >=15% after compaction runs in experiments
Automated integration tests covering correctness under hot-path batching, KV prefetch flow, and compaction-triggered allocation churn
design_decisions: Use event-time coalescing window (rather than fixed-slot alignment) so we keep high aggregator utilization for bursty short requests without changing existing slot allocator semantics

Prefetch will operate at the granularity of KV-shard identifiers derived from model shard map; heuristic uses recent sequence-length histogram and per-client prefix match rate to decide whether to prefetch full KV or partial ranges

Compaction is implemented as a non-blocking post-eviction pass that attempts to call CUDA allocator trimming (cudaFreeChain or allocator-specific shrink API) during low-utilization periods; compaction is gated by compaction_threshold to avoid constant pauses
Backpressure: when coalescing window causes queue depth to exceed soft_qdepth_limit, fall back to slot-level immediate scheduling to preserve latency SLOs
implementation_notes: Add new BatcherCoalescer component in serving/runtime/batching with input queue timestamping and a min_wakeup timer per worker
Integrate KV prefetcher in routing path: when batch is formed, compute union of hot KV keys and issue async prefetch RPCs to local shard cache before GPU decode starts
Expose metrics: coalesced_requests_count, coalesce_window_ms_actual, prefetch_requests, prefetch_hit_ratio, compaction_runs, allocator_fragmentation_ratio
Add configuration knobs to model serving profiles and per-tenant overrides in routing policy
Ensure thread-safety for prefetch futures and make prefetch cancellation idempotent when batch rescinds or model fallback occurs
Instrument memory compaction to be no-op on allocators without supported shrink APIs; guard with runtime capability check
test_plan: Unit tests: timing logic for coalescer, prefetch request generation correctness, compaction trigger logic
Integration: synthetic replay traces with mixed lengths (short chatty clients + long doc completions) to measure p50/p95/p99 and KV hit/miss latencies
Chaos: inject KV backend slowdowns and artificial memory pressure to validate fallbacks and ensure compaction doesn't increase tail latency
Staging A/B: roll flag to 10% of traffic for a subset of models (low-risk models) with detailed tracing enabled
Load test: 24h soak with peak bursts to measure fragmentation over time and compaction effectiveness
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal canary on dev cluster with synthetic suites (feature flag off by default)
Phase 1: Enable coalescing with coalesce_window_ms=3, prefetch_enabled=false for 10% traffic on staging; validate latency and correctness
Phase 2: Turn on prefetch heuristics for the same cohort; measure KV miss reduction and tail impact
Phase 3: Enable compaction in monitor-only mode (record expected compaction actions without forcing allocator calls) for two days
Phase 4: Controlled enable compaction (compaction_threshold tuned conservatively) for 5% production traffic, progressively ramp to 25% if metrics stable
Rollback criteria: >5% sustained increase in p50 or >10% increase in error rate, or prefetch_hit_ratio<10% after warmup
metrics: error_rate and tail-decoding-failures correlated with coalescer enablement
